dedupe_keys.name: dreal pays de la loire drinking water datasets

description: DREAL Pays de la Loire: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Pays de la Loire. Coverage: DREAL Pays de la Loire. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Communes concernées par un PAC SUP Canalisations en Pays de la Loire; Zone de protection de l'aire d'alimentation du captage (ZPAAC) en Pays; Aire d’alimentation du captage (AAC) en Pays de la Loire; Aire d’alimentation du captage (AAC) en Pays de la Loire (Hors région). Formats seen: WFS, WMS, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
